g.text: PANEL A: DIGITAL TRAJECTORY REGIME (VOLUME III)
Reversible State Space
1. Thermodynamic State & Invertibility
• Finite Reversal Time: T_reversal < ∞ (Instantaneous software reset)
• Zero Physical Entropy: Erroneous tokens consume only electricity, leaving zero residue
State Invariant: Speculative actions are 100% discardable
2. Environmental Containment Boundary
• Ephemeral Sandboxes: Firecracker microVMs, Docker containers, chroot namespaces
• Storage Isolation: Copy-on-Write (CoW) overlays, temporary Git worktree branches
Complete Mediation: OS kernel blocks unauthorized host side-effects
3. Rollback & Compensation Mechanisms
• Deterministic Compensation: Saga ledger executes inverse actions (C_k ... C_1)
• Snapshot Restoration: git reset --hard, ZFS snapshot rollback, database ROLLBACK
Recovery Guarantee: Trajectory abort cleanly restores clean baseline
4. Verification Oracle & Exploration Policy
• Fast Mechanical Oracles: Compilers, type-checkers, unit test suites (pytest, cargo test)
• Aggressive Trial-and-Error: Best-of-N sampling, Monte Carlo Tree Search, rollouts
Safety Barrier: Software oracles evaluate candidate prior to final commit
THE DIGITAL AGENT SYSTEMS CONTRACT
• Fault Model: Fail-Plausible (Model emits syntactically plausible but invalid code)
• Host Defense: Wrap model in strict type checking and sandbox test runners
• Primary Bottleneck: Context window drift, memory bus bandwidth, serving economics
VOLUME III FOCUS: Constructing the accountable digital software runtime.
PANEL B: PHYSICAL EMBODIED REGIME (VOLUME IV)
Irreversible State Space
1. Thermodynamic State & Irreversibility
• Infinite Reversal Time: T_reversal = ∞ (Thermodynamics forbids entropy rollback)
• Physical Damage: Broken pipettes, shattered glass, chemical explosions, robotic collision
Physical Reality: Once voltage reaches actuator, action is committed forever
2. Out-of-Band Hardware Interlock Boundary
• Hard Physical Interlocks: Optical light curtains, limit switches, current-limiting relays
• Isolated Microcontrollers: Formal safety state machines executed on verified PLCs
Air-Gap Defense: Safety logic runs completely out-of-band of AI neural software
3. Absence of Post-Hoc Rollbacks
• No Undo Primitives: You cannot "un-aspirate" toxic acid or "un-drop" expensive samples
• Real-Time Emergency Stop: Hardware ESTOP power cut-off is the sole failure mitigation
Recovery Reality: Failures require physical repair and decontamination
4. Kinematic Safety Envelopes & Clamping
• Deterministic Envelope Clamping: Neural trajectories clamped to safe velocity/force bounds
• Zero Trial-and-Error in Production: Exploration strictly confined to high-fidelity physics sims
Safety Invariant: Drives check commands against invariant geometry
THE EMBODIED PHYSICAL AI CONTRACT
• Fault Model: Fail-Safe Emergency Stop (Drop power; lock mechanical brakes)
• System Defense: Independent PLC / FPGA safety circuit clamps model torques
• Primary Bottleneck: Sensorimotor latency jitter, physical wear, non-invertibility
VOLUME IV PREVIEW: Transitioning from digital software to physical agency.
